benefits.text: BBIA Last Contour Stick - AI Edition contour and highlighter stick is the perfect solution for contouring and highlighting, all in one AI Dual Stick. It enhances standout features and creates a 3D effect on the face with natural contouring and a highlighter, giving a pearl-like makeup finish. The product helps add depth to the nose, slim the look of the face and make the lip line look fuller. With a smooth texture, even color payoff and no skin irritation, the stick delivers standout yet natural results.

howToUse.text:
Please use on areas that need definition, such as the nose, jawline, lip line, under-eye area and collarbones. 
Take only the amount needed and apply to the desired area. 
After use, close the cap and store horizontally.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Multi-purpose 2-ended contour and highlighter stick that helps define facial features naturally and conveniently.

sellingPoints.text: 2 ends for contour & highlight; creates a 3D effect; smooth texture, even color payoff.

texture.text: Smooth cream stick, glides easily and blends easily.

claimDisclaimers.text: Use “slim” only in the sense of a makeup effect, not a change in facial structure.
